title: •IG-88’s Neural Inhibitor
caption: •IG-88’s Neural Inhibitor (V)
game_text: Use 1 Force to deploy on a bounty hunter (free on IG-88). May target a character for free. Draw destiny. Target captured (and opponent loses 2 Force if target is a {maintenance} or {lightsaber} character) if destiny +1 > defense value.
lore: Mennotor DAS-430 electromagnetic projectile launcher. Often mistaken for a blaster rifle. Fires small hollow darts filled with neurotoxin which cause temporary paralysis.

notes: Unique. Curly apostrophe in the slip's title line and caption. Two inline icons in 'is a [gold spoked wheel] or [black square, green blade] character': transcribed as {maintenance} and {lightsaber} per this run's instructions (the stub expands them as 'Rebel or Jedi'; the wheel is the maintenance icon per the VS3 cover key, and the black-square green-blade glyph is the Permanent Weapon icon per STANDARD.md rev 8 — same glyph). Lore corrected from scan: first word reads 'Mennotor' (two n's) on both the Dagobah scan and the VB2 remake; wiki has 'Menotor' — only 350 px scans exist, so the reading is from the glyph spacing. Base scan only at 350 px; copyright 1997 (Dagobah) not legible. Modern: Virtual Block 2 only (VB2 -pre, 350 px).
